meta.title: About us — property care team in Mauritius
meta.description: Meet Bellavere: property management and syndic services across Mauritius — full transparency, no hidden fees, and always a human to answer you.

hero.title: Care you can see, from people you can reach
hero.intro: {marketLong} Looked after in person and reported openly, with never a hidden fee.

paragraphs.first: At {company}, {krit} and {ankit} work to the promises in our mission: full transparency, no hidden fees, and a person who answers whenever something goes wrong.
paragraphs.second: In practice, every cost is itemised and visible on your dashboard. And whenever you message us, a person answers — {krit} on the ground, {ankit} as your first point of contact. From single villas to the common areas of whole residences, that is how we look after every property.

values.title: Three promises we make to every owner

transparency.title: Full transparency
transparency.copy: Every rupee and euro in and out of your property is itemised on your dashboard and your monthly statement. You see exactly what we see.

noHiddenFees.title: No hidden fees
noHiddenFees.copy: One clearly stated management fee. No surprise charges and no invented extras — if something costs you money, it is on your statement with a line explaining why.

human.title: Always a human
human.copy: Call or write any time: someone is reachable every day, 24/7, and every query is answered the same day. A real person who knows your property — never a chatbot.

team.title: The main people you will speak to
team.sub: Three people, one standard. Small enough that you always deal with someone who knows your property.

items.contact: One reliable point of contact for everything
items.fee: A fee negotiated with you after our first meeting — never more than {maxFee, number, percent}. No hidden fees.
items.human: A person answers every message — never a bot
items.supervision: Work on your property supervised on site, in person
items.dashboard: A live owner dashboard, day and night, from anywhere
items.currencies: Prices and statements in rupees or euros — your choice
items.maintenance: Preventive maintenance, inspections and owner reporting
items.syndic: Syndic and common-area management for whole residences

coverage.title: All around the island
coverage.sub: We look after properties across the whole of Mauritius — north and south, coast and plateau — and {krit} supervises work and inspections on site, in person.
